units.source_text: 二女公子想起浮舟受了委屈，很可怜她，

en.t: The Second Princess remembered how Ukifune had been wronged and felt deeply sorry for her,

units.source_text: 便装作不知此事，派人去对她说：“皇后患病，亲王进宫去探望了，今夜不回家来。

en.t: so she pretended not to know about it and sent someone to tell her, "The Empress is ill, and the Prince has gone to the palace to visit her, so he will not come home tonight.

units.source_text: 我想是今天洗发之故，身体也不舒服，到现在还不曾睡。

en.t: I suppose it is because I washed my hair today, but I do not feel well either, and I still have not slept.

units.source_text: 请你到这里来坐坐吧。

en.t: Please come here and sit with me for a while.

units.source_text: 想你也是寂寞无聊的。”

en.t: I imagine you must be lonely and bored too."

units.source_text: 浮舟叫乳母代答：“我心情不好，非常痛苦，想休息一下。”

en.t: Ukifune had her nurse answer for her, "I feel unwell and am in great distress, so I would like to rest for a while."

units.source_text: 二女公子立刻又叫人来慰问：“心情怎样不好？”

en.t: The Second Princess immediately sent someone again to ask after her, saying, "In what way do you feel unwell?"

units.source_text: 浮舟答道：“也说不出怎样不好，只觉得非常痛苦。”

en.t: Ukifune replied, "I cannot really say in what way I am unwell; I only feel terribly distressed."

units.source_text: 少将君和右近使个眼色，说道：“夫人心中定然非常难过呢！”

en.t: Lady Shosho and Ukon exchanged glances and said, "Her Ladyship must surely be suffering greatly at heart."

units.source_text: 这也是因为这妹妹非比别人，所以夫人特别关心。

en.t: This too was because this younger sister was unlike anyone else, and so the lady cared for her especially.

units.source_text: 她想：“此事实甚遗憾，浮舟也太不幸了。

en.t: She thought, "This matter is truly regrettable, and Ukifune is far too unfortunate.

units.source_text: 薰大将屡次说起对她的恋慕之情，如果闻知此事，定会当她是个轻薄女子而看她不起。

en.t: General Kaoru has often spoken of his love for her; if he hears of this, he will surely think her a frivolous woman and look down on her.

units.source_text: 像亲王那样荒淫无度的人，有时会把毫无根据之事说得非常难听；反之，有时碰到确有几分荒谬之事，却又满不在乎。

en.t: A wanton, unrestrained man like the Prince may sometimes speak very harshly about things with no basis at all; conversely, when something is actually rather improper, he may treat it as nothing.

units.source_text: 但薰大将不然，他口上虽不说出，而心中怀着怨恨，真是个善于隐忍而修养功深的人。

en.t: But General Kaoru is not like that; even if he says nothing aloud, he harbors resentment in his heart, for he is truly a man deeply practiced in restraint and self-discipline.

units.source_text: 浮舟身世飘零，又添上了一重不幸。

en.t: Ukifune's life has already been adrift, and now another layer of misfortune has been added.

units.source_text: 多年以来，我从未和她相识会面，如今一见，觉得她的性情和容貌可爱而又可怜，教人不能抛舍。

en.t: For many years I had never known or met her, but now that I have seen her, I find both her nature and her appearance lovable and pitiable, making it impossible to abandon her.

units.source_text: 人生在世实在太艰辛，太痛苦了！

en.t: Life in this world is truly too hard and too painful!

units.source_text: 就我自身境况而论，不称意之事虽然甚多，但可能和她同样遭逢不幸而终于不曾落魄，总算是有面子的。

en.t: As for my own circumstances, although there have been many things that did not go as I wished, I may have met misfortunes like hers yet never fallen into ruin, so at least I have preserved my dignity.

units.source_text: 现在，只要那个讨厌的薰大将不再来缠绕我，乖乖地断绝了念头，我就更无可忧之事了。”

en.t: Now, as long as that hateful General Kaoru stops pestering me and obediently gives up his hopes, I will have nothing more to worry about."

units.source_text: 她的头发很多，一时不易干燥，起居很不方便。

en.t: Her hair was very abundant and did not dry easily for some time, making her daily movements quite inconvenient.

units.source_text: 她身穿一套白衣，窈窕可爱。

en.t: She wore a set of white garments and looked graceful and lovely.
